content.title: About Texas Christian University (TCU) in Fort Worth, Texas
content.text: Main Content Only Here. TCU began as a progressive and personal college for men and women with a dream to learn and lead. 150 years later, we are still that place. Mission & History The world has changed since Fort Worth was home to “Hell’s Half-Acre.” But TCU's promise has stayed the same. Our Mission, Vision & Values Our Family History This Is TCUSee All Quick Facts 26Average class size 11,152Undergraduate students 1,828Graduate students 100,000Living alumni Traditions TCU is a place of spirited belonging where Horned Frogs have long found connection through our culture and traditions. The Amazing Horned Frog A Cheer Heard 'Round the Century Leadership Our powerful academic community starts at the top and influences everything we do. Horned Frogs lead by example. Our Chancellor Our Provost Board of Trustees ❚❚ Pause Leaders Are Made Here. At TCU, Lead On is more than a motto, it's a call to action. TCU Alumni Leaders Strategic Plan The world spins forward. We’re building a campus and community for future generations. The plans we imagine and develop today will ensure a bright future for our students and the lives they touch.
